observations.behavior: Adds a conditional skip for trunk-merge/** branch names in desktop backend coupling check, while retaining the check for same-repo PRs.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a CI guardrail. It prevents a desktop PR from being rejected by a backend coupling check when the desktop PR is bundled with a backend PR in a trunk-merge queue. This could preserve the CI status of a desktop PR that would otherwise fail a backend-only check, assuming the trunk-merge batch is considered a valid, checked unit.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional skip for trunk-merge/** branch names in migrations separation check, while retaining the check for same-repo PRs.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a CI guardrail. It prevents a migration PR from being rejected by a migrations separation check when the migration PR is bundled with other PRs in a trunk-merge queue. This could preserve the CI status of a migration PR that would otherwise fail a separation check, assuming the trunk-merge batch is considered a valid, checked unit.
